headline: FROYO KEEPS GROWING: FOUNDERS METALS HITS 54.0M AT 8.45 G/T GOLD INCLUDING 24M AT 17.42 G/T IN PARALLEL VEIN
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Founders Metals (TSXV: FDR)
snippet: Founders Metals (TSXV: FDR) extended the Froyo Zone at its Antino Project in Suriname with hole FR256 returning 54.0 metres at 8.45 g/t gold from 303m depth, including 24.0m at 17.42 g/t — drilled on a parallel structure approximately 100m east of the high-grade zone in FR249. The result continues to define a large, high-grade gold system with multiple vein sets and step-out potential across the district.

headline: REVIVAL GOLD CONFIRMS JOSS TARGET CONTINUITY: 8.4 G/T OVER 6.2M AND 8.5 G/T OVER 3.4M AT BEARTRACK-ARNETT IDAHO
snippet: Revival Gold (TSXV: RVG) reported wedge-hole drilling results from the Joss target at its Beartrack-Arnett Project in Idaho, with two holes returning 8.4 g/t gold over 6.2m and 8.5 g/t gold over 3.4m — supporting overall continuity of high-grade mineralization ahead of an updated resource estimate. The Joss target is being developed as a standalone near-surface resource within the broader Beartrack-Arnett gold system, which already holds a PEA-level resource.

headline: NORTHWEST COPPER HITS 41.7M AT 1.13% CUEQ FROM 72.6M AT KWANIKA NORTH PIT EXTENSION
snippet: NorthWest Copper (TSXV: NWST) reported hole K-26-303 intersecting 41.7 metres grading 0.40% Cu, 0.67 g/t Au and 1.13% CuEq from just 72.6m depth at the Kwanika North Pit Extension in BC — a shallow, open-pittable intercept expanding the near-surface copper-gold envelope. The result supports a potential pit-constrained resource expansion at Kwanika, one of BC's more advanced copper-gold porphyry development projects.

headline: GALLEON GOLD ZONE #9 STEP-OUTS ALL HIT: 2.52 G/T OVER 26.5M CONFIRMS HIGH-GRADE CORE CONTINUITY
snippet: Galleon Gold (TSXV: GGO) reported that all four step-out holes around the Zone #9 high-grade core at its West Cache Project intersected gold mineralization, including WC-26-246 returning 2.52 g/t gold over 26.50m. The 100% hit rate on step-outs confirms the structural continuity of Zone #9 and supports an upcoming resource update at one of Ontario's emerging high-grade gold targets.

headline: KRAKATOA RESOURCES FIRST ASSAYS AT ZOPKHITO: 1.8M AT 11.09 G/T GOLD AND 3.56% ANTIMONY IN GEORGIA
snippet: Krakatoa Resources (ASX: KTA) received first assay results from its 2026 drill program at the Zopkhito Antimony-Gold Project in Georgia (the country), with all four initial holes confirming high-grade gold and antimony mineralization within Vein 6. Results include 1.8m at 11.09 g/t gold and 3.56% antimony, with individual peak samples hitting 17.1 g/t gold and 15.3% antimony — a strategic antimony supply play given rising Western demand for the critical defense metal.

headline: RPX GOLD EXTENDS HIGH-GRADE ZONE WITHIN PEA PIT: 25.50 G/T GOLD OVER 4.26M INCLUDING 135 G/T OVER 0.71M
source_name: Junior Mining Network / RPX Gold (TSXV: RPX)
snippet: RPX Gold (TSXV: RPX) reported that drilling has further extended high-grade gold mineralization within the existing PEA open-pit shell, with a hole returning 25.50 g/t gold over 4.26 metres including 135.00 g/t gold over 0.71 metres. The result adds high-grade ounces within a pit already constrained by a preliminary economic assessment, improving the project's grade profile and potential economic metrics.

headline: GOLD CLIMBS BACK TO $4,164 ON GEOPOLITICAL FLOWS — MARKET TESTS WHETHER FED PRESSURE HAS BOTTOMED
snippet: Gold edged back to $4,164-$4,177/oz on October 6, up $24.60 on the day, as renewed geopolitical risk appetite partially countered the Federal Reserve rate-hike pressure that had dragged bullion to a two-month low of $4,121 earlier in the week. Analysts note gold's $4,000 floor is holding as central banks continue absorbing physical supply, though the direction of the next Fed meeting remains the dominant near-term price driver.

headline: BMO WARNS: SILVER'S 120% SURGE LOOKS OVERBOUGHT — "GOLD REMAINS KING" AS SUPPLY DEFICIT NARROWS
snippet: BMO Capital Markets is cautioning that silver's 120% surge from 2025 lows has pushed the metal into overbought territory, forecasting Q4 2026 silver prices will average ~$60/oz with consolidation risk ahead. BMO reiterated gold as the "King of Precious Metals" for the near term, noting silver's supply deficit is narrowing per updated models even as industrial EV and solar demand remains strong.

headline: URANIUM LONG-TERM PRICES HIT 18-YEAR HIGH AT $94/LB — KAZATOMPROM CUTS 10%, STRUCTURAL DEFICIT REACHES 20M LBS/YR
snippet: Uranium long-term contract prices have reached an 18-year high of $94/lb, inverting above spot as utilities scramble to lock in decade-long supply certainty. Kazatomprom lowered its 2026 production guidance by ~10% (from 85Mlb to 71-75Mlb) citing sulfuric acid shortages for in-situ recovery operations, while Cameco faces independent operational headwinds — together widening the structural annual deficit to an estimated 20 million pounds of U₃O₈.

headline: CHINA NORTHERN RARE EARTH RAISES OCTOBER LISTING PRICES ACROSS MULTIPLE PRODUCTS MOM
snippet: China Northern Rare Earth Group published its October 2026 listing prices showing multiple rare earth products — including neodymium-praseodymium and dysprosium — rising month-on-month, a signal of tightening domestic supply and sustained downstream magnet demand. The price lift comes as Western producers race to build non-China separation and magnet capacity under U.S. executive order timelines mandating defense supply chain diversification by January 2027.

headline: AOCE LIFTS COPPER PRICE DECK — WHAT A HIGHER FORECAST MEANS FOR JUNIOR COPPER MINERS
snippet: Following Goldman Sachs raising its end-2026 copper target to US$13,735/t and Citigroup maintaining a $15,000/t year-end view, the Association of Canadian Copper Explorers (AOCE) updated its member company price deck — lifting NAV calculations for junior copper developers and increasing the valuation floor for early-stage projects. Chile's copper output fell to a 15-year low in September, reinforcing analyst bullishness on the structural supply squeeze.

headline: SILVER47 SOIL SURVEY REVEALS 1.5KM HIGH-GRADE VEIN NETWORK AT NEVADA PROJECT — DRILL TARGET DEFINED
snippet: Silver47 Metals (TSXV: AGA) released soil survey results from its Nevada property highlighting a 1.5km high-grade vein network and a 500m by 600m gold geochemical anomaly — defining a new high-priority drill target. The result expands the company's Nevada exploration footprint beyond its existing silver-gold resource and positions Silver47 for a first-drill milestone at the new Nevada discovery.
